description:
Contains the name of the key type - "RSA", "ECDSA", "PEM" .

"RSA": an RSA key pair, using settings.size as .size. "ECDSA": an Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm key pair, using settings.curve as .curve. Note that ECDSA keys cannot be used for encryption but only for signature. "PEM": a key pair definition in PEM format, using settings.pem as .pem.
